#572 no-consumer audit: generic turns are parked in runtime-event-handlers/turn-terminal.mjs after worker.turn_reported; root_turn_reported is only delivered when BatonDeployment passes rootWakeDelivery into WebNorthbound (application-deployment.mjs rootWakeTarget/rootWakeDelivery). run.changes()/BatonRun.complete and deployment watch are observation surfaces; complete returns at required turn_checkpoint and deployment watch only prints frames. No durable attachment/lease proves an active subscriber, so a wake-stream subscription cannot satisfy admission implicitly. Minimal fix: extend DRIVER_KINDS with an explicit caller-owned/manual kind for embedded orchestrators; require either that durable explicit driver declaration or a validated deployment rootWake target at Application.approve(), immediately before approvePlan/_dispatchCurrent. CLI/MCP/web generic runs have no manual declaration and therefore require advanced.rootWake/BATON_ROOT_WAKE; waves keep driverKind wave; swarm runs retain SwarmNativeAccess. Refuse application_turn_consumer_required before approval/dispatch. Manual means the caller actively observes and explicitly selects nudge_turn, claim_turn, or stop; it supplies no automatic continuation. Migrate only fixtures that intentionally own paused turns to driverKind manual.
